description: This file implements two classes for Inworld AI Text-to-Speech (TTS) services: an HTTP-based service (InworldHttpTTSService) and a WebSocket-based service (InworldTTSService). It includes methods for starting, stopping, canceling, and generating TTS audio streams, handling WebSocket connections, processing responses, and managing word timestamps. The classes support features like streaming, non-streaming, context management, and metrics collection.

classes.name: InworldHttpTTSService
classes.description: HTTP-based TTS service supporting streaming and non-streaming modes, with word timestamps and audio processing.

classes.name: InworldTTSService
classes.description: WebSocket-based TTS service with bidirectional streaming, context management, and real-time audio handling.

methods.name: can_generate_metrics
methods.description: Indicates support for metrics generation.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the service, setting sample rate and other parameters.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the service and closes connections.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels ongoing TTS operations and disconnects.

methods.name: push_frame
methods.description: Handles incoming frames and updates internal state accordingly.

methods.name: _calculate_word_times
methods.description: Calculates word timestamps from API response, maintaining cumulative timing.

methods.name: run_tts
methods.description: Main method to generate TTS audio, yielding frames for streaming or non-streaming responses.

methods.name: _process_streaming_response
methods.description: Processes streaming response chunks, decodes audio, and updates timestamps.

methods.name: _process_non_streaming_response
methods.description: Processes complete non-streaming response, decodes audio, and updates timestamps.

methods.name: _process_audio_chunk
methods.description: Processes individual audio chunks into frames.

methods.name: _handle_interruption
methods.description: Handles interruption frames, manages context and connection state.

methods.name: _get_websocket
methods.description: Returns the current WebSocket connection.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes WebSocket connection and starts receiver and keepalive tasks.

methods.name: _disconnect
methods.description: Closes WebSocket connection and cancels tasks.

methods.name: _connect_websocket
methods.description: Handles WebSocket connection setup with headers and error handling.

methods.name: _disconnect_websocket
methods.description: Closes WebSocket and cleans up context.

methods.name: _receive_messages
methods.description: Receives and processes incoming WebSocket messages, handling audio chunks and context events.

methods.name: _keepalive_task_handler
methods.description: Periodically sends keepalive messages to maintain WebSocket connection.

methods.name: _send_context
methods.description: Creates a new audio context on the server.

methods.name: _send_text
methods.description: Sends text to be synthesized over WebSocket.

methods.name: _send_flush
methods.description: Sends a flush command to process buffered text.

methods.name: _send_close_context
methods.description: Closes the current audio context on the server.

methods.name: run_tts
methods.description: Generates TTS audio via WebSocket, managing context and connection.
